parts_to_keep: One accountable local CPTO and optional remote handoff, not a mandatory Owner message bus.
Repository grounding, product-local admission, hard constraints and prohibited substitutions.
Complete outcome, adaptive delivery map and bounded increments.
Risk-matched implementation, test, repair and independent-review loops.
Rule against repeating materially identical failed repairs without new investigation.
Product-local canonical knowledge, accepted decisions, unapproved ideas and derived contexts.
Capability truth separated from authority and limited to the actually verified workflow.
Explicit manual-only specialist lanes and honest physical session-limit handling.
Existing traceability validators and narrowly scoped fingerprint-bound read-only runner.
parts_to_replace: Mutable STATUS/checklists as authoritative execution state: replace with rebuildable projections of a transactional journal.
Self-asserted completion booleans and caller-selected required predicates as runtime proof: replace with contract-bound evidence verification.
Single global blocker classification as scheduler state: replace with per-predicate waits and independent runnable frontier.
Prompt-only authority enforcement: replace with authenticated versioned grants and non-bypassable per-effect gates.
Transcript/manual-message continuation as a required execution mechanism: replace with durable supervisor-driven recovery.
Blind retries after uncertain effects: replace with adapter-specific idempotency and authoritative reconciliation.
Advisory single-writer discipline alone: augment with isolated worktrees, fencing and serialized CAS integration.
